sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the verified applicability, owner, units, inclusive/exclusive thresholds, spacing comparison, span/ice-class alternatives, all-region scope, and direct-calculation alternative. Deterministic validation is valid; no repair or vocabulary matching is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the span-scope alternatives. For frame_span_m > 4, require explicit representation of antitripping support for all regions and all ice classes; the current branch only checks frameSpan and therefore permits a presence-only approximation. For frame_span_m <= 4 with iceClass IA Super, require the all-regions scope as well; that branch currently omits hasAntitrippingSupportRegion. Locate and use canonical controlled term(s) for all-regions/all-ice-classes scope rather than inventing IRIs, and preserve the existing IA bow+midbody and IB/IC bow branches. Keep the equivalent-support calculation branch as the sole alternative that bypasses these prescriptive scope checks.

The span-scope alternatives now represent the required all-region, IA, and IB/IC scopes and preserve the equivalent-calculation alternative. Correct the spacing SPARQL constraint: its nested FILTER NOT EXISTS logic accidentally allows missing spacing when frameAsymmetrical=true or when frameWebAngleToShell is below 90 degrees. Encode the violation condition as (frameAsymmetrical = true OR angle < 90) AND NOT EXISTS spacing with numericValue <= 1300, while retaining the inclusive threshold and millimetre unit. Do not activate vocabulary matching; all required canonical terms are already supplied.

The candidate faithfully encodes the verified applicability, owner, units, inclusive/exclusive thresholds, spacing comparison, span/ice-class alternatives, all-region scope, and direct-calculation alternative. Deterministic validation is valid; no repair or vocabulary matching is required.
